notes.title: Lighting Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Have you been thinking about torch lighting and flame effects a lot recently? SAME HERE!  I have just completed a massive update to the torch and lighting in the game, and am very excited about how it turned out! I have uploaded all new screenshots to showcase this.  Check them out in the top section.

Thank you for your interest in The Weald! I can't wait to see what you think once it's released!
[hr][/hr]
Elliott

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's taken a little longer than I thought to find and contract voice actors for this project, and so I have pushed back the release date to ensure I can deliver the best experience possible.

I am also using this time for beta testing, and have received some valuable feedback which I am using now to make the core gameplay more enjoyable.

Thank you for your interest in The Weald! I can't wait to see what you think once it's released!
